comment: Round-2 fix verified. I confirmed via runtime.py:951-972 that _svc() resolves the ai_invoke_service module at call time and returns the same module object on every call, and via worker.py:2038-2071 that _inbox_register assembles the envelope exactly once at line 2051 (body = _svc()._register_envelope(context, run, tool_input)), reusing dict(body) copies for the dry-run and real requests. So the test's monkeypatch lands on the exact live attribute the production code reads, independent of whether another test module has already imported ai_invoke_service.
